title: About: Story (From the trading floor to tr…)

f1.default: From the trading floor to trading independently.

f2.default: How nearly 10 years of independent trading began, and why it shapes the way Learn Try Earn teaches.

f4.default: A seat on a London trading floor.

f5.default: My interest in financial markets originally led me to consider a career in investment banking in London, with the ambition of working on a trading floor. I was drawn to the analytical thinking, fast-moving environment and challenge of making decisions as markets responded to events around the world.

f8.default: As I considered the direction I wanted my life to take, I decided that trading independently was a better fit for me. It offered the freedom to develop my own approach and build my working life around my priorities, while taking responsibility for my own decisions.

f11.default: You have to establish your own structure, question your judgement and accept the consequences when an idea does not work out.

f14.default: Those principles shape the approach I want to share through Learn Try Earn: explaining the markets I trade and helping you build a clearer understanding of trading.
